exposure: Nepal Perinatal Quality Improvement Package (NePeriQIP) intervention
outcome: fetal heart rate monitoring performed as per protocol
time intervals between each fetal heart rate monitoring
progress of labor recording immediately after per vaginal examination
cohort: The study included 25,977 deliveries in three public hospitals in Nepal.
finding: The NePeriQIP intervention improved several aspects of obstetric care, including fetal surveillance and documentation practices, and was associated with a higher cesarean birth rate.
mod_finding: The cesarean birth rate was 2.5% in the control group and 8.2% in the intervention group, showing a significant increase in the intervention group.
